text: No, there is no tree-cover loss candidate on this property after 2020. The latest observation from Hansen GFC (2025) detected a loss event in 2025, but this occurred *after* the 2020 baseline. The JRC 2020 reference confirms 65.7% of the asset was forested in 2020, with no post-2020 loss events recorded. The 2025 loss (3.9% of the asset) does not meet the "after 2020" criterion. No other datasets (e.g., MGAP) were available to corroborate changes.
